title: On the weighted logarithmic potential operator
summary: For a bounded open set $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^N$ with $N\geq 2$, and for positive continuous functions $w,g$ on $\overlineΩ$, we consider the weighted eigenvalue problem \begin{equation*} \mathcal{L}_{w} u =τgu, \end{equation*} where $\mathcal{L}_{w}$ is the weighted logarithmic potential operator on $L^2(Ω)$ as defined below: \begin{equation*} \mathcal{L}_{w} u(x)=\int_Ω\log\left(\frac{w(x)w(y)}{|x-y|}\right)u(y)dy. \end{equation*} We study the monotonicity and continuity of the largest positive eigenvalue $τ_{w,g}^+(Ω)$ with respect to $Ω$, $w$, and $g$.
